name: SaltCON
blurb: Utah's board game and RPG convention, running multiple weekends a year in Layton and at Bryce Canyon.

editions.evidence: Homepage: 'January Bryce: Jan 15-17, 2027 ... Ruby's Inn Bryce Canyon, UT' (badges for this weekend show as sold out)
Homepage: 'Twice: Jan 22-24, 2027 Ruby's Inn Bryce Canyon, UT' and 'SaltCON Bryce Twice Badges on Sale Now!'
Homepage: 'March Mar 11 - Mar 14, 2027 Davis Conference Center Layton, UT 2500+ Attendees! Full Vendor Hall...'
Homepage: 'June June 11-13 2027 Davis Conference Center Layton, UT 1200+ Attendees! 2600+ Game Library...'
Homepage: 'September Sep 3-5, 2027 Davis Conference Center Layton, UT 1200+ Attendees! 2600+ Game Library...'

notes: SaltCON is one brand/organizer running five weekends across the window: two back-to-back 'Bryce' weekends at Ruby's Inn near Bryce Canyon in January, plus Spring/June/September weekends at the Davis Conference Center in Layton -- recorded as five editions in this one file rather than splitting by city, since it is a single organizing team's recurring calendar (not separate city franchises like FAN EXPO). No guest-of-honor program found anywhere on the site (no 'guest' mention in the homepage text, nav, or links); this is a vendor/exhibitor/game-library tabletop convention, so guests is 'none' throughout. No organizer company name found on-site.
